name: Fayetteville
intro: Northwest Arkansas has become a regular part of my filming map, and honestly, it's easy to see why couples are drawn up here. I've filmed twice at Crystal Bridges in Bentonville — my favorite venue anywhere, full stop — and my weddings across the region have taken me from the Stone Chapel at MattLane Farm in Fayetteville to Mildred B. Cooper Chapel in Bella Vista to Osage House in Cave Springs. Between the Ozark scenery, the architecture, and the energy of downtown Bentonville and Fayetteville, NWA weddings hand a videographer a different kind of canvas than anywhere else in the state.

I'm based in Little Rock, and I make the drive to Northwest Arkansas regularly — it's a straight shot up I-49 that I've done enough times to plan a wedding day around confidently. That distance comes with a simple, transparent travel policy and zero surprises: you'll see the exact number in your quote before you ever book. If you're getting married in NWA and want a film that matches the setting, the drive has never once stopped me.

faqs.question: Do you travel to Northwest Arkansas, and what does it cost?
faqs.answer: Yes — I film in NWA regularly. Travel is included within 50 miles of Little Rock, then a flat $1 per mile beyond that. For most NWA venues that works out to a straightforward line item you'll see clearly in your quote — no estimates, no surprises, no hidden fees.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: NWA's popular venues book early — Crystal Bridges and the glass chapels especially — so nine to twelve months out is the safe window. I take one wedding per date, always; a retainer locks yours in.

faqs.question: When will we get our films?
faqs.answer: Your Instagram reel arrives within 48 hours of your wedding. Your full film is delivered by a guaranteed date that's written into your contract — you'll know exactly when to expect it.
